description: Queue the looping cover GIF of one of the workspace's recipes (2 s, 360x640, on a sample clip: the recipe's grade, caption style and motion, a title with its animation and one transition) and say where it stands. sample_media_id is one of the workspace's video clips (its first 2 s, muted); without it a built-in sample is used. The GIF is an approximation drawn on the server. State is none, queued, rendering, done or unavailable (this server cannot draw covers); call again to see it finish. At most 20 previews an hour per workspace.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

sample_media_id.description: A ready video in this workspace to use as the sample (see media_list)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_preview
title: Draw a recipe's cover GIF
